description: List law-reform projects run by the Law Commission of England & Wales (lawcom.gov.uk/project) — the workstreams under which its consultation papers and reports are published, e.g. "Commercial leasehold" or "Consumer class actions". Optionally narrow by status. Welsh-language duplicates are filtered out, one row per project.

status.description: Filter by project status: "current", "completed", "upcoming", or "other". Omit to list all statuses.

name: list_law_commission_projects
